opening.argument: The speaker questions whether NEAR's AI infrastructure has produced agents that are ready, in production, and widely used. The discussion treats automated financial activity and possible savings as a vision, not a guaranteed return or an invitation to pay or authorize an agent. It describes NEAR as a long-term bet with clear risk and says definitive proof is still forthcoming. The speaker also warns against bots promising easy money, while the description says the material is educational rather than investment advice. These are the marks of critical market analysis, not a solicitation.

citations.quote: But that is not the same as having autonomous agents, ready, simple, running in production, and used massively by ordinary people.
It is a long term asymmetric bet, with clear risk and clear potential.
But the definite proof is still on the way.
If you see someone recommending experts or bots promising easy money run, Because it's scam, because no one will give you anything!
El contenido de StickBitcoin es meramente informativo y educativo, y NO constituye una recomendación de inversión, compra o venta de ninguna criptomoneda.
